links.outcome: Pill recognition accuracy across different hospital clinical datasets and platforms
links.effect: On clinical datasets from 3 hospitals, accuracy fluctuated (20.62%-90%) depending on dataset and platform, versus 80.83%-91.60% on the verification dataset with the full training set.
links.quote: On clinical datasets, accuracy fluctuated (20.62%-90%) depending on the dataset and platform.

unlisted_practices: Comparing code-based versus AutoML platforms for pill recognition model development, cost, and training time

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of computer vision approaches (code-based YOLO vs cloud AutoML platforms) for pill identification across clinical and lab image datasets, evaluating technical performance, cost, and feasibility without testing an organizational deployment safeguard.
